tagline: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4 is retired as of October 9, 2026.
what_it_does: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4 is retired as of October 9, 2026. Claude Sonnet 4.6 is the recommended replacement. This page describes the model maintenance policy for the Foundation Model APIs pay per token, Foundation Model APIs provisioned throughput, Batch Inference with ai query, and Foundation Model Fine tuning offerings.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
